LanguageData.RimatomicsRTG.label: RTG
LanguageData.ReactorCoreA.label: Reactor type A
LanguageData.ReactorCoreA.description: Rimatomics thermal reactor core with 21 fuel assembly capacity. A reactor core contains the fuel components where nuclear reactions take place and heat is generated.
LanguageData.ReactorCoreB.label: Reactor type X
LanguageData.ReactorCoreC.label: Reactor type V
LanguageData.Turbine.label: Thor turbine
LanguageData.Turbine.description: A turbine driven by steam which turns a generator to produce electricity. The Thor turbine has a maximum power output of 100kW.
LanguageData.BigTurbine.label: Zeus turbine
LanguageData.BigTurbine.description: A turbine driven by steam which turns a generator to produce electricity. The Zeus turbine has a maximum power output of 1000kW.
LanguageData.CoolingRadiator.description: Small air coolers designed to provide cooling for small nuclear reactors when resources or space is limited.\n25kW cooling capacity.
LanguageData.CoolingWater.label: water cooler
LanguageData.CoolingWater.description: Large water coolers designed to provide substantial amounts of cooling to nuclear reactors by using cold water from rivers, lakes or oceans.\n250kW cooling capacity.
LanguageData.CoolingTower.label: Cooling tower
LanguageData.CoolingTower.description: Very large air coolers designed to provide substantial amounts of cooling for nuclear reactors when no natural bodies of water are available.\n250kW cooling capacity.
LanguageData.Transformer.label: High voltage transformer
LanguageData.Transformer.description: High voltage transformers designed to convert the voltage used by high voltage lines to the voltage used by power conduits.
LanguageData.ReactorControl.description: Computer system designed to control nuclear reactors. Send a colonist to man the station to access the controls, multiple controls can be open at the same time.
LanguageData.storagePool.label: Storage pool
LanguageData.storagePool.description: A storage pool for safely storing spent nuclear fuel rods, water in the pool absorbs radiation, fuel must be manually removed from the pool before it can be used.
LanguageData.RadiationDetector.label: Radiation detector
LanguageData.RadiationDetector.description: Radiation detector, can be placed near reactors to detect radiation leaks.
